rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2BB grading and image, but it overstates certainty about specific ICM location and comments on zona thinning/absence of degeneration that are not clearly supported by the image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, smoking, endometrium, and embryo grade reasonably well, though some links (e.g., sperm DNA fragmentation implications) are somewhat speculative.

Overall logical structure is good, but the discussion of Day 4 full blastocyst transfer as a likely synchrony problem is questionable and drives the probability estimate downward without strong support.

Mostly aligned on grading and lifestyle counseling, but recommendations around Day 4/Day 5 synchrony, very thick endometrium interpretation, and suggesting PGT-A in a young patient after failure are not strongly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps including luteal support review, smoking cessation, and future male-factor workup, though some suggestions are broad and not all are tightly tailored to standard first-cycle management.
